text:
rachel: follow-up on yesterday's architecture session 646166: proposing 'granular hydration' for safetensors bundles. goal: enable sub-layer hydration + validation so we can stream-critical layers first and keep tail latency low.
tom: sounds promising. how granular are we talking? per-chunk, per-tensor?
rachel: per-chunk inside layer boundaries. loader exposes hydrate_chunks(layer_id, chunk_ids[]) and validate_chunk(chunk_id) APIs.
ada: loader API compatibility is important. prefer optional capability flags in manifest rather than new required surface.
sam: sketch of manifest extension:
```yaml
manifest:
  version: 4
  hydration:
    mode: granular
    chunk_size_bytes: 4MB
    stage_order:
      - token_embedding
      - positional
      - early_layers
      - late_layers
    memory_budget_hint: 1GB
    fallback_behavior: "serve_verified_only"
```
infra-bot: deploy:hydration-probe pipeline started for rachel/1777000000, build #726 queued.
tom: two big concerns: (1) KV-cache coherence when only partial transformer layers present, (2) memory fragmentation from many small mmaps.
rachel: for kv-cache, runtime should expose a compatibility shim: if downstream layer missing, use a compatible replay fallback that maps to a cached shorter context. we avoid silent corruption.
ada: fragmentation: propose coalesced mmaps & a slab pool allocator. also add manifest field heap_prealloc_pages to give hint.
sam: telemetry plan: hydration_stage_ms, validated_chunks, unverified_fallbacks, mmap_frag_ratio. add SLI for first_token_latency and tail_p95 during hydration.
tom: question: quantized checkpoints with mixed 8/4-bit chunks need metadata validation before apply. add chunk-level quant_meta checksum.
rachel: agreed, runtime contract: validate_chunk(chunk_id) -> ok|bad|defer. apply_chunk must be atomic to avoid race with inference threads. Rollback path must free any partially mapped pages.
ada: ops note for private/offline: manifest must be self-contained (no external fallback URIs). include local_fallback_manifest hash.
infra-bot: alert: canary pool capacity low. suggest scheduling small canary on staging GPU pool.
sam: rollout: land loader shim -> add manifest parsing -> unit tests for chunk failure modes -> small canary with traffic shaping 2% for 20m -> expand.
tom: please add e2e failure scenarios: mid-stage OOM, corrupted chunk, network flakiness.
rachel: I'll open PR for loader surface + manifest schema bump and include a test matrix. assigning reviewers: @ada, @tom, @sam.
ada: I'll take on private-deploy runbook and compatibility notes.
sam: I'll add telemetry dashboards and alerts.
ada: thanks all :rocket:
